title: Answer: the grain of conscious time is the loop propagation time

statements.text: The theory takes time from ordinary physics. What it adds is that the temporal resolution of experience, seen in masking, the attentional blink and flicker fusion, comes from the time activity takes to travel from layer 5 neurons through the nonspecific thalamus and back.

sources.quote: if conscious perception is based on the processing within the thalamocortical loop, then it is hard for conscious perception to resolve anything that happens faster than the processing time of this loop
